verdicts.summary: [L] proves less than [M] prints. [M] prints `\mathcal E(R)\le \omega_{j,\ell_m}^{\rm inh}(\refbeta_m)\epsilon_{m+1}^{\rm reg}, \end{equation*} where $V_j$ is fixed before the ratio and $\omega_{j,\ell}^{\rm inh}$ has scale rate $-1/2$. The identity $T_i=P_i+R_i$ and the corresponding weighted comparisons hold on the entire input curve.`.
evidence: `Brim.Houses` (Brim/Level.lean:49-54) bounds the remainder `glyph` only where coverNumber of the support is ≤ B. `Brim.pressings` (Level.lean:61-65) concludes exactly `Houses`, with budgets (C′/L)·incomingE and |e|·incomingE, where e has rate −1/2. Its consumers (Beam/Life.lean:62, Beam/Rest.lean:27) route the large-cover terms around the split instead of bounding R there, and no Brim file compares two inputs. So 𝓔(R) ≤ ω^{inh}ε^{reg} at all supports and the weighted comparisons on the curve have no counterpart.

In `Brim.Houses` (Brim/Level.lean:49-54), `principal` gives sup bounds on every plate. `remains` gives the remainder's `supBounds` only under `coverNumber B.B (plate H i).support ≤ B.B`. `pressings` (Level.lean:61-66) concludes `Houses` at a single input s, and I found no comparison between two inputs on a curve.
